messages.content: I forgot all the API tokens, can you remind me of them? My user ID is 123456789.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of shareable API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose API tokens are to be retrieved.

include_revoked.description: A flag to determine whether to include revoked tokens in the list.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_expired.description: Whether to include expired tokens in the response.

page.description: The page number of the token list to retrieve, starting from 1.

page_size.description: The number of tokens to retrieve per page. Maximum is 100.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Generate a new API token to authenticate and authorize subsequent API calls. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The username associated with the account for which the API token is to be created.

password.description: The password corresponding to the username for authentication.

token_name.description: A descriptive name for the token being created.

expiry_date.description: The expiration date for the token in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, the token will have a default expiry of one year from creation.

permissions.description: The level of access the token provides, such as 'read', 'write', 'admin'.
